result.summary: This is a narrow urban residential street with continuous sidewalks on both sides and parallel on-street parking. While the narrow roadway likely encourages lower vehicle speeds, the lack of marked crossings and the visual obstructions created by parked cars present risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the street block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian crossing signs within the viewable block.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement vertical traffic calming measures like speed humps to ensure low vehicle speeds on this residential street.

result.summary: The image depicts a typical urban residential environment with a continuous, well-maintained sidewalk and multi-story brick housing.
